newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila says cancels futures bourse licence.
newsitem.headline: Manila says cancels futures bourse licence.

text.p: The Philippine Securities and Exchange Commission said on Monday it had decided to revoke the license of the Manila International Futures Exchange (MIFE).

"The commission en banc...decided to order the immediate revocation of the secondary franchise or the licence of MIFE to operate as a futures exchange and the licences of all commodity futures brokers as well as the licence of the Manila International Futures Clearing House," the SEC said.
The SEC suspended MIFE operations on June 20, 1996 due to complaints from the public of widespread irregularities.
The exchange had offered contracts in copra, sugar,dry cocoon, soybeans, coffee and major currencies but traders said its trading volumes were very low. The exchange had less than 10 brokers.
MIFE officials were not immediately available for comment.
